content: MAUI Blazor Hybrid + Web App: MAUI apps always run interactively and throw on Razor pages that explicitly specify a render mode (dotnet/aspnetcore#51235); use global interactivity or the InteractiveRenderSettings indirection that nulls render modes under BlazorWebView; template maui-blazor-web -I {Server|WebAssembly|Auto}. Source: learn.microsoft.com blazor/hybrid/tutorials/maui-blazor-web-app.
